steps.name: tool-layover-connection-calculator
steps.summary: Created layover-connection-calculator tool: airportMctData.ts (22 airports, 4 connection types, 2 verified IATA sources), layoverCalculator.ts (evaluateLayoverTime pure fn, 3 verdicts), LayoverConnectionCalculatorTool.tsx (searchable dropdown + free-text IATA entry), page.tsx (EN/KO SSG), tools-config.ts entry added. 23 new tests, 449 total pass, build generates /en|ko/travel/layover-connection-calculator.

steps.name: tool-jetlag-recovery-calculator
steps.summary: Created jetlag-recovery-calculator tool: jetlagCalculator.ts (calculateJetlag pure fn — shortest-path UTC-offset normalisation, eastward 1 day/zone, westward 1 day/1.5 zones, validated against Waterhouse et al. Lancet 2007), 15 unit tests pass (464 total), JetlagRecoveryCalculatorTool.tsx (UTC-offset dropdowns, result card with recovery days + direction badge + day-by-day guide for east/west), page.tsx (EN/KO SSG, openGraph images, source citation), tools-config.ts entry added (disclaimerType general + extra safety paragraph for sleep/mood disorders). Lint clean, build generates /en|ko/travel/jetlag-recovery-calculator.
